About me

Most of my work sits where development meets security.

I am a final-year Computer Science student who enjoys building products end to end: React and TypeScript on the front, Node.js and Express behind it, Firebase for data and authentication, and AI APIs for the smart parts.

Security is the thread through all of it. I use threat modeling, code review, and dependency scanning as part of building, not as an afterthought. I have also attended cybersecurity conferences and university events to keep learning from people already working in the field.

I am looking for a junior software or security engineering role in Saudi Arabia or the UAE where I can keep building and learning.
